Name: Abigail, Daughter of Nahash
Role: Sister of Zeruiah; Mother of Amasa
Summary: Abigail, daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah, was the mother of Amasa by Ithra. She is distinct from Abigail, Nabal's widow, who became David's wife.
KeyStory: Abigail daughter of Nahash mothered Amasa, the commander Joab murdered.
RelatedPeople: Zeruiah; Amasa, Son of Ithra; Ithra
LifeLesson: Two Abigails, two houses — the record keeps each woman's story straight.
